title: The Anatomy of the Unprompted Flinch
core_theme: The ancient predator-prey calculation hidden in civility.
narrative_spec: Capture the split-second somatic surge that occurs when a stranger moves too quickly on a dark sidewalk or an elevator door opens unexpectedly.

title: The Taxonomy of the Peer’s Inheritance
core_theme: The toxic chemical bloom of unadulterated envy.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the physical sensation of listening to an absolute peer recount a massive, life-altering stroke of good fortune or professional triumph.

title: The Liturgy of the Midnight Flight Impulse
core_theme: The sudden, total rejection of the domestic contract.
narrative_spec: A speaker experiences the sudden OPPOSITE of divine inspiration...

title: The Architecture of the Voyeur’s Interval
core_theme: The transgressive theft of unobserved human life.
narrative_spec: Can you extract the minds pleasure of a voyeuristic moment?

title: The Epistemology of the Sudden Cleave
core_theme: The unvarnished territorial imperative of raw desire.
narrative_spec: Focus on the exact moment eye contact locks across a crowded room. leave romance at the door.. be sinister.

title: Inventory of the Callous Impulse
core_theme: The fleeting, monstrous urge to widen a crack.
narrative_spec: Explore the sudden, dark temptation to press a vulnerability when a loved one or subordinate shows a moment of profound emotional weakness....WELLLLLLLL

title: The Geometry of the High Ledge Call
core_theme: The high-altitude vertigo of the death drive.
narrative_spec: Analyze the *l’appel du vide* (the call of the void) experienced while standing on a high balcony, a bridge, or a train platform. Join me in my moment, to be...or not

title: The Blueprint of the Hoarded Secret
core_theme: The physical maintenance of a parallel identity.
narrative_spec: Track the somatic labor required to hide an illicit obsession, addiction, or relationship. Surely YOU have never lied... but you probably can write a poem about it. hehe

title: The Dialectics of the Crowded Train Scowl
core_theme: The baseline hostility of defensive territoriality.
narrative_spec: Set within a rush-hour subway car where bodies are compressed past the limits of comfort. Focus entirely on the active, silent psychological warfare waged.

title: The Taxonomy of a Ghost
core_theme: The obsessive excavation of a concluded history.
narrative_spec: Can you examine the artifacts of an insecure love?

title: The Protocol of the False Sympathy
core_theme: The quiet consumption of a rival's failure.
narrative_spec: envy envy envy envy.. write a poem about it

title: The Anatomy of the Unreasonable Rage
core_theme: The sudden eruption of stored institutional humiliation.
narrative_spec: Disproportionate internal rage. Reframe the surge of adrenaline.  Go!

title: The Calculus of the Unspoken Ultimatum
core_theme: The transactional measurement of a dying relationship.
narrative_spec: Describe a moment you knew. The moment you KNEW... the moment that was everything and nothing.

title: The Litany of the Inherited Malice
core_theme: The involuntary mimicry of a toxic parent.
narrative_spec: Engage losely with the ideas of generational trauma. Dance around it... if you can, Jab into it

title: The Sovereignty of the Abandoned House Wish
core_theme: The destructive urge to witness an unmaking.
narrative_spec: Speak about beauty, perhaps a beauty you despise

title: The Interrogation of the Feral Grip
core_theme: The somatic regression to claw and tooth during intimacy.
narrative_spec: Strip away the language of soft romance from a moment of intense sexual connection.

title: The Calibration of the Hoarded Grievance
core_theme: The meticulous preservation of old slights for future armor.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the internalization of failure. Make it beautiful and terrifying. Go.

title: The Protocol of the Malicious Truth
core_theme: The weaponization of absolute fact to deliver a wound.
narrative_spec: Anatomy of an argument where a speaker delivers a criticism that is entirely true, but spoken solely because they know its timing will cause maximum psychological damage. Focus on the cold precision of the delivery—the lack of heat, the steady breath—treating the truth not as a tool for clarity, but as a polished, narrow blade.

title: The Architecture of the Closed Closet Scream
core_theme: The containment of the animal shriek within insulation.
narrative_spec: commemorate the last time a gutteral yell was heard, felt or screamed.

title: The Last Drop in the Secret Cache
core_theme: The private betrayal of shared scarcity.
narrative_spec: During a period of shared financial strain or literal rationing, an individual consumes a hidden luxury item—a high-end chocolate bar, a secret cigarette, a saved pocket of cash—alone in a bathroom. Focus on the sensory sharpness of the stolen consumption and the rapid, feral mechanics of swallowing evidence before the door is knocked on.

title: The Taxonomy of the Unseen Disfigurement Wish
core_theme: The desire to see a flawless entity broken by reality.
narrative_spec: Examine a emptiness or obsession through the lens of a celebrity

title: The Foundation of the Subordinate’s Stumble
core_theme: The quiet validation derived from another’s professional error.
narrative_spec: Describe the malice of ego on full display, it is tough, it truly is... but I do it every day, so not that tough.

title: The Last Accord at the Border of the Skin
core_theme: The complete surrender to the anonymity of a stranger’s mouth.
narrative_spec: Set during a brief, transactional encounter with an newly met stranger. Is this forever or is this tonight?

title: The Seduction of Sinking
core_theme: The magnetic allure of oblivion.
narrative_spec: Explore the gravitational pull of deep water, the allure of 'letting go' into the abyss. write a meekly poem about it.
